answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. What survives to the willow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. A dune of per-task receipts records who did what, and the vine of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
